pages.text: Fishing is a piece of cake! Just make sure you have a rod and bait that can be used together. Then place the bait next to the fishing rod on your hotbar, and fish away like vanilla!
pages.title: Fishing
Lava Fishing
pages.text: In the $(thing)Nether$(), a Mariculture rod's hook floats in lava just as it does in water, and fish bite there too. Whatever you pull out of the lava is fire-proof until you pick it up.
